prior_credit.earlier_candidate_layer: p202 B2 and B3 were already unreviewed OCR-derived bodies in experiments/p73_new_methods/retrieval_inputs.json, blocks p202_ocr_block4/5. The opening and final source parts were not coherently read in that selected corpus.
prior_credit.bounded_body_check: No explicit p202 or Generalintendant body example was located in the inspected author manuscript, canonical supplementary readings, or current catalog. This is a bounded attribution check, not proof of historical priority.
prior_credit.contribution: Source-certified multipart edition with a conditional opening loss model, newly readable address/responsibilities and final-part text, and explicit coordinate costs. No new period-key recovery is claimed.

gap_audit.model: Exactly five consecutive unknown coordinates inserted at each of the 224 possible boundaries of the 223-coordinate source; no observed coordinate deleted or reordered.
gap_audit.selection_scope: Templates are editorial reconstructions derived after viewing candidate readings, not independent cribs or blind controls. Address and reference fields are masked in the ordinary-word comparison. All tied minima are retained. The representative group-boundary 145 is not called a unique recovered geometry.

candidate_finding_scores.source: Both frozen 37-symbol book and radio-mixture tables ranked the unfilled gap 146 first; this is only candidate finding, with the already demonstrated wildcard-marginalization bias. It does not override the source-layout alternatives or certify a true loss location.
